name: exp-012-blend-2
description: The standing blend as shipped 2026-09-05: four general members equally weighted, plus exp-010's NM-tail head as a specialist inside the nm_late regime only.

blend.why: The desk's rule for four general members is flat unless a fitted vector beats flat in EVERY rotation; it does not (NNLS wins only december, by 0.001). N1-nmtail then earns 0.297-0.336 inside nm_late across the three rotations and exactly 0.000 in nm_bulk, so it is carried as a regime specialist. As a fifth general member it is worth -0.492 s.

members.name: T-tailv2
members.budget: prc.tail_model declares n_estimators 500 (main) / 300 (noac head); no early stopping, so the multi-month budget rule does not apply - what this member needs instead is a scan to justify the constants.
members.notes: noac head pinned to v2 by NOAC_PIN in the producer. The OOF is exp-009's versioned v2 file, byte-identical to what these weights were fitted on.

members.name: C2-cat
members.budget: 5325 rounds from a single early-stop month (2025-11), rescaled by 12/11 to 5809. NOT compliant with the multi-month budget rule; bringing it into compliance costs about 1.3 GPU-hours.
members.notes: The only GPU member. GPU 1 per docs/COMPUTE.md compute allocation, which counts 2 feeding CPU threads against this lane's cap.

members.name: L2-hub
members.budget: 2100 rounds from a single early-stop month (2025-11), rescaled by 12/11 to 2291. Not compliant by method but VALIDATED by measurement: the patience-900 alternative of 8725 rounds scores 314.41 on july_loo against this arm's 310.84, so the count is right even though the instrument that drew it is the disfavoured one.

members.name: D1-winter
members.budget: 150 rounds, drawn under the multi-month budget rule: per-month optima 2025-07 109, 2025-01 129, 2025-11 142, median 129, relative spread 0.256 (inside the 0.5 threshold so the median applies), rescaled by the mean held fraction. The single-slice instrument it replaced drew 165.
members.nondeterminism: linear_tree=True, which LightGBM's deterministic=True does not cover across thread counts. Measured: the same seed at the same thread count drew 148 rounds on one run and 186 on another and scored 307.45 against 311.30 on july_loo, against a seed-to-seed spread of 3.7 s on the same fold. The blend is insensitive to it - a 0.77 s change in this member moves the board estimate 0.014 s.
members.notes: The OOF is exp-007's single-seed arm while the served member is a three-seed twelve-month bag; that mismatch is measured at 0.014 s and disclosed rather than assumed away. UNDER REPAIR: the robustness audit found this member carries the full unbounded 25-column day-state block.

members.name: N1-nmtail
members.budget: prc.nmtail declares n_estimators 900 with no early stopping, so the multi-month budget rule does not apply; what it needs instead is a scan to justify the constant.
members.notes: Predicts NM-joined departures only; y_pred is null on 5,290 non-NM ranking rows. prc.blend VERSION 5 permits that ONLY because this member's weight outside nm_late is exactly 0.000, and verifies it rather than trusting it.
